description: This PHP source file defines the 'CalendarDashlet' class, which extends the Dashlet class to provide a calendar widget for a SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for rendering the dashlet, handling configuration options, and initializing calendar-related objects.

classes.name: CalendarDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class for displaying a calendar view within SuiteCRM, configurable for different views like week or day, and capable of rendering calendar content and options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the calendar dashlet with provided ID and settings, loading language strings, and creating a seed Calendar bean.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the calendar dashlet content by loading required calendar classes, checking access permissions, and outputting the calendar.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays configuration options for the dashlet, including title and view type.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves the configuration options received from a request.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Returns any JavaScript needed for the dashlet; currently returns an empty string.
